info.name: CeView — Module 4: Campaign Analytics & PES Reporting
info.description:
Complete Postman collection for UC-4.1 (data ingestion), UC-4.2 (PES compute), and UC-4.3 (AI prescriptive report). Three request directions are covered:
  1. Frontend → Spring Boot  (POST /api/v1/analytics/manual)
  2. Spring Boot → FastAPI   (POST /internal/pes-compute/analyze)
  3. FastAPI → Spring Boot → Frontend  (final structured response)

All monetary values are in Philippine Peso (₱).

item.name: 1. Frontend → Spring Boot  (UC-4.1: Manual Data Ingestion)

request.description:
Operator submits raw campaign values from the DataIngestionForm.

Spring Boot:
  1. Computes KPIs (CTR, CPC, CR, ROAS, CAC)
  2. Persists to tbl_campaign_records via JPA
  3. Forwards raw data to FastAPI /internal/pes-compute/analyze
  4. Updates the DB record with the returned PES score
  5. Returns MetricsResponse to the frontend

FR4.26: if FastAPI is unavailable, a rule-based PES is computed by Spring Boot and the UI response is identical.

response.name: 200 OK — MetricsResponse (success path)

item.name: 2. Spring Boot → FastAPI  (UC-4.2: PES Compute from Raw Data)

request.description:
Forwarded by Spring Boot AIInferenceGatewayService.computePesFromRaw().

FastAPI pipeline:
  1. Base metrics:    CTR=4.8%, CPC=₱0.69, CR=2.5%, ROAS=3.2x, CAC=₱62.50
  2. Normalization:   Min-Max scaling with calibrated Cebu MSME bounds
  3. Inversion:       CPC and CAC inverted (lower cost → higher contribution)
  4. PES formula:     ROAS×0.35 + CR×0.30 + CAC_inv×0.15 + CTR×0.15 + CPC_inv×0.05
  5. Edge cases:      flags zero-value metrics, recalibrates weights proportionally
  6. AI insights:     DeepSeek identifies weakest funnel stage + 3 recommendations
                       (rule-based fallback if DeepSeek is offline — FR4.26)

response.name: 200 OK — Full PES Compute Response (AI online)
200 OK — FR4.26 Rule-Based Fallback (AI offline)

item.name: 3. FastAPI → Spring Boot → Frontend  (UC-4.3: Full AI Report — PES Analysis Agent)

request.description:
Triggers the LangGraph pes_report_agent deep-analysis.

Spring Boot builds a synthetic 4-week time-series from the stored campaign metrics,
forwards it to FastAPI /internal/pes-analysis/generate, which runs the Gemini
structured-output agent with up to 3 quality-gated iterations.

This produces the exact output format matching the sample data in the task brief.

response.name: 200 OK — Final AI Report (LangGraph agent output matching brief sample)

item.name: 4. Edge Case — Missing newCustomers (FR4.26 Weight Recalibration)

request.description:
newCustomers = 0  →  CAC is FLAGGED and EXCLUDED.

FastAPI recalibrates remaining weights proportionally so they still sum to 1.0:
  ROAS: 0.35 / 0.85 = 0.4118
  CR:   0.30 / 0.85 = 0.3529
  CTR:  0.15 / 0.85 = 0.1765
  CPC:  0.05 / 0.85 = 0.0588

The flagged_metrics array will contain 'CAC (newCustomers = 0)'.
The PES score is still valid and meaningful despite the missing data.

response.name: 200 OK — CAC flagged, weights recalibrated

item.name: 5. Spring Boot — GET Default Metrics (EngagementMetricsBoard seed)

request.description: Returns pre-computed default KPIs for the EngagementMetricsBoard when no manual data has been ingested yet. Pass weeks=8 to scale the demo values for an 8-week analysis window.
Returns the PES score + qualitative label + per-metric breakdown used by PESComputationBoard's gauge and horizontal bar chart.

Triggers the AIActionPlanReport funnel diagnostics. Spring Boot enriches the payload with computed metrics + pre-ranked funnel transitions, then delegates to FastAPI /internal/report/generate (Gemini). Falls back to rule-based diagnostics if FastAPI is unavailable (FR4.26).
